text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: multi-GPU collective stall detected in prod (cluster: west-eu-inference-2), severity: P1

devon: I got the page, jumping in. seeing repeated NCCL TIMEOUT on TP4 shards, jobs stuck at allreduce.

maria: Any customer-facing impact yet?

devon: Initial check: about 12 active inference pipelines impacted, primarily models pinned to tp4-32x. Latency > 30s, some hard fails with CUDA Xid 79.

sam: Logs from the node:```
[2026-03-17T10:05:12Z] ncclCommAllReduce() -> TIMEOUT after 120s
[2026-03-17T10:05:13Z] GPU0: CudaError(Xid=79) driver reset
[2026-03-17T10:05:14Z] container runtime: oom-kill signal on pid 2145 (model-server)
```

eng-runtime: Noted pattern: KV cache growth + long sequence workloads causing OOMs, then NCCL handshake loss -> allreduce stalls.

ops-lead: Immediate mitigation suggestions?

devon: Propose steps: 1) cordon node eu2-gpu-17, 2) restart model-server containers on affected nodes, 3) failover affected requests to single-GPU fallback model variants, 4) increase NCCL timeouts to 180s temporarily.

maria: I'm executing cordon + drain on eu2-gpu-17 now. tagging @support-bot to surface impacted customers. :point_down:

support-bot: Notifying customers with active requests: AcmeCorp, FieldLens, Notesly. Sending status: "We are investigating a performance degradation on inference for models using multi-GPU pipelines."

sam: Rolling restart of model-server on eu2-gpu-18 in progress. seeing container OOMs on restart, increasing container memory limit + enabling swap on ephemeral path.

eng-runtime: Quick patch: enable prefix KV eviction for affected shards (reduces memory, might increase token latency slightly). Pushing change to runtime flag now.

ops-lead: Any signs this is correlated with a recent rollout?

devon: No config rollouts in last 6h. but a platform kernel upgrade landed on eu2 nodes yesterday — possible driver interaction. collecting kernel and driver versions.

maria: Handoff to night oncall @devon -> @maria for monitoring. Summary: cordoned eu2-gpu-17, restarted containers, enabled KV eviction, requests rerouted to fallback single-GPU variants, customer notifications sent.

devon: Action items for next shift: 1) validate driver/kernel combo on eu2 fleet, 2) run synthetic allreduce test across TP4 nodes, 3) consider rolling back kernel if repros.

eng-runtime: We've also enabled temporary NCCL debug logging (netinfo) and increased handshake timeout. will keep logs for postmortem.

support-bot: Customers acknowledged update, AcmeCorp opened a ticket asking for ETA.

ops-lead: Monitoring shows error rate falling, latency trending down after reroutes. keeping pager open for 4h. :white_check_mark:

maria: I'll take over oncall, leaving notes in incident doc. If errors reappear escalate to infra and driver team.

incident-bot: Pager status: acknowledged -> investigating -> mitigation applied. Next update scheduled in 30m.

devon: Quick note: avoid redeploying model quantization changes until we confirm stability.

maria: Acknowledged. ending active mitigation thread; leaving watch.

support-bot: Final customer note queued: "Stability improvements applied; we will follow up with postmortem and mitigation timeline." :mailbox_with_mail:
